questions.question:
A woman introduces a man as the son of the brother of her mother. How is the man related to the woman?
(a) Brother
(b) Uncle
(c) Nephew
(d) Cousin
questions.explanation:
Woman's mother's brother is her maternal uncle.
The man is the son of her maternal uncle => Cousin .

questions.question:
If A is the brother of B, C is the sister of B, and B is the father of D, how is D related to A?
(a) Nephew/Niece
(b) Niece
(c) Nephew
(d) Cousin
questions.explanation:
A is the brother of B => A and B are siblings.
C is the sister of B => A,B,C are siblings.
B is the father of D => D is nephew / niece for both A and B

questions.question:
If A is the mother of B, B is the son of C, and C is the brother of D, how is D related to A?
(a) Brother-in-law
(b) Uncle
(c) Nephew
(d) Cousin
questions.explanation:
A is the mother of B => A is a female.
B is the son of C => C is  a parent (Mother/Father) of B.
C is the brother of D => C is a male and C is B's Father => D is B's Uncle/Aunt and A's Brother-in-law/Sister-in-law

questions.question:
If A is the sister of B, B is the daughter of C, and C is the wife of D, how is D related to A?
(a) Father
(b) Uncle
(c) Grand Father
(d) Cousin
questions.explanation:
A is the sister of B =>  A and B are siblings.
B is the daughter of C => C is the mother of A and B .
C is the wife of D => D is husband to C => D is A's and B's Father.

questions.question:
If A is the husband of B, B is the mother of C, and C is the wife of D, how is A related to D?
(a) Father-in-law
(b) Grandfather
(c) Nephew
(d) Cousin
questions.explanation:
A is husband of B.
B is mother of C => A is father of C.
C is wife of D => D is son-in-law of A / A is father-in-law of D.

questions.question:
If A is the brother of B, B is the son of C, and C is the daughter of D, how is D related to A?
(a) Uncle
(b) Grandfather
(c) Nephew
(d) Cousin
questions.explanation:
A is brother of B => A and B are siblings.
B is the son of C => C is a parent(Mother/Father) of A and B .
C is the daughter of D => C is mother of A and B => D is grandparent (Grandfather/Grandmother) to A.

questions.question:
If A is the sister of B, B is the daughter of C, C is the wife of D, and D is the brother of E, how is E related to A?
(a) Uncle
(b) Grandfather
(c) Nephew
(d) Cousin
questions.explanation:
A is sister of B => A and B are siblings.
B is the daughter of C => C is a Parent(Mother/Father) of A and B.
C is the wife of D => C is the mother and D is the father of A and B.
D is the brother of E => E is Paternal Uncle/Aunt for A and B.

questions.question:
If A is the brother of B, B is the son of C, C is the daughter of D, and D is the wife of E, how is E related to B?
(a) Uncle
(b) Grandfather
(c) Mother
(d) Grandmother
questions.explanation:
A is brother of B => A and B are siblings.
B is the son of C => C is a Parent of A and B.
C is the daughter of D => C is mother of A and B => D is Maternal Grandparent for A and B.
D is the wife of E => D is the Maternal Grandmother and E is the Maternal Grandfather for A and B.

questions.question:
If A is the sister of B, B is the daughter of C, C is the wife of D, and D is the brother of E, how is E related to C?
(a) Brother-in-law
(b) Grandfather
(c) Nephew
(d) Cousin
questions.explanation:
A is sister of B => A and B are siblings.
B is daughter of C => C is parent for A and B.
C is wife of D => C is mother  and D is father for A and B.
D is brother of E => E is Brother-in-law/Sister - in -law for C.

questions.question:
Introducing a boy, a girl said, “He is the only son of my mother’s mother. How is the girl related to the boy?
(a) Mother
(b) Aunt
(c) Niece
(d) Cousin
questions.explanation: Son of my Mother's Mother => Son of my Grandmother => The boy is her Maternal Uncle / She is the boy's niece.Also Check:➣ Test your knowledge- Quiz!
